name: Orc_Siege_Arsenal_Hex_V1

design: Original orc siege arsenal: low broad basalt-and-heavy-timber assembly shed with genuinely open front bay, hex-clipped rust-red stepped roof, transverse horned ridge, forge chimney and large silver cog with tusks on clan-red sign. Foreground static four-wheeled reinforced torsion catapult with loaded open spoon, iron nose and ivory tusks; angled timber crane with chain, open hook and suspended spare axle. Wheel and timber stocks, stone ammunition tray, anvil, hammer and parchment assembly plan. Same regular catapult/trebuchet/bombard line; legendary siege colossus belongs to separate mastery building. No unit dependencies, animation or perimeter wall ring.
notes: Studio and scale reference excluded from export. Separate editable source parts; consolidated game meshes by architectural group.
faction_tint: Cog backing cloth and miniature catapult nose plate isolated in Faction mesh for future owner tint. No runtime integration.
